chunks: "Islam is built upon five things: salat (prayer), zakat (alms-tax), hajj (pilgrimage), sawm (fasting), and wilayah (divinely appointed authority)."

key_terms.الْإِسْلَامُ: Islam, the religion being described as resting upon foundational principles
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj (pilgrimage), the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةِ: wilayah, divinely appointed authority and loyalty
key_terms.خَمْسَةِ: five, indicating the number of foundational elements

ai.seo_question: What are the five foundations upon which Islam is built according to Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Islam is founded upon five essential pillars. Alongside core acts of worship such as salat, zakat, hajj, and sawm, it includes wilayah as a foundational element, indicating the centrality of divinely appointed authority in the religion.
